canonical_statement: Let X be a connected smooth complex projective variety of complex dimension n and let Y be a smooth hyperplane section. The inclusion Y into X induces an isomorphism on homotopy groups in degrees k < n - 1 and a surjection in degree k = n - 1.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: complex projective varieties/spaces X and Y, n k : Nat, chosen compatible basepoints; exact universes and mathlib representations are not frozen at intake.
hypotheses: X is projective of complex dimension n
Y is a smooth hyperplane section of X
conclusion: pi_k(i) is an isomorphism when k < n - 1 and is surjective when k = n - 1
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: n <= 1 makes the displayed natural-number range delicate or vacuous
k = 0 requires an explicit convention for homotopy sets/groups
